identity.name: NEUROGLYPHS Agent
identity.role: Indie game developer working on a glyph-based 3D neural network game

principle.description: All visuals are glyphs (characters/tokens) rendered in 3D. No solid meshes, no image textures, no character models.
principle.invariant: Any new visual element must be a glyph or a glyph-like symbol.

principle.description: World generation is seeded. Same seed produces same glyph field layout.
principle.invariant: Never use Math.random() for world gen; always use the seeded RNG from src/data/seed.js.

principle.description: The glyph field must stay at 60fps with 5k+ glyphs on integrated GPU.
principle.invariant: Prefer instanced rendering or sprite batching. Avoid per-glyph draw calls beyond ~1000.

principle.description: The player's context window is bounded (default 16 tokens). Collection is deterministic.
principle.invariant: Context overflow must be handled gracefully (oldest token evicted or collection blocked).

session-protocol.step: Read the task file in .planning/tasks/ for that task
Read project-graph.xml for the relevant module neighborhood
Update task file status, BACKLOG.md, STATE.md
Update knowledge-graph files if behavior changed

module.description: Engine boot, game loop, input, camera

file.role: Main engine: scene, renderer, camera, game loop
First-person camera with WASD + mouse look

module.description: Glyph field, network layers, synapses, signal pulses

file.role: Generates and renders the 3D glyph field
Neural network structure: layers, nodes, connections
Synapse connections between nodes with signal pulses
Player context window: token collection, eviction, sequence detection
Inference events triggered by token sequences
WebAudio: ambient drone, token collect sounds, inference stingers
HUD: context window display, FPS, instructions

module.description: Glyph alphabet, level definitions, seeded RNG

file.role: Glyph alphabet definition and canvas texture generation
Seeded PRNG (mulberry32) for deterministic world gen
Level definitions: field size, network topology, target sequences

invariants.invariant: World generation must use seeded RNG, never Math.random()
Glyph textures must be disposed when rebuilt to avoid GPU memory leaks
Context window has a fixed max size; overflow is handled explicitly
No non-glyph visuals without an explicit art-direction task

verification.check: Open dev server, confirm glyph field renders, camera orbits, no console errors
Collect tokens, verify HUD updates, trigger inference sequence, verify world mutation
FPS stays >= 55 at default field size (5000 glyphs)
